Doc.Summary: The pointer shapes of the canvas. Avalonia has no standard open hand, closed hand or magnifier, so these are drawn from the Material icons the tool column already uses, with a light fill and a dark outline that show on both themes. If a cursor cannot be created, a standard cursor is used instead.
Turns the Core color of a shape into a brush, for swatches. It does not convert back.
Turns the Core color of a shape into an Avalonia color and back. Alpha is kept.
